decisions.why: Exactly the FR-004 list the accepted spec carries (round 1 ruled the carve-out legitimate); all 14 ledger mentions are rows, so leaving them is FR-004's 'rows written before this feature'; the dev/*-log CLAUDE.md files name the prefix 0 times.

decisions.summary: guards re-pointed, each with a test on the new path
the old-layout check exempts the whole of docs/review-ledger.md (and so any future row)
decisions.why: FR-004 makes only ledger rows written BEFORE this feature verbatim; a row written after the move is a live file under FR-007. Exempting the whole file lets a new row name the dead path, the exact failure FR-007 exists for. Not impossible: exempt only the ledger lines present at the move commit (a baseline set of lines, or check the ledger's delta).

decisions.summary: carry leaves a file at the old place when one exists at the root, so the old directory survives
decisions.why: FR-008/SC-004 require no .claude/skills/diagram/ left behind. Measured 2026-10-07 (find over /diagram/.clones/*): 9 clones hold .ruff_cache at BOTH the root and the skill dir, and CACHEDIR.TAG/.gitignore collide by name, so the carve-out is the common case, not a corner. FR-008 already provides the route: a cache that cannot be carried is invalidated with the reason recorded. Fix: on collision a cache copy at the old place is invalidated (recorded); any other file is moved to a non-colliding name at the root (never deleted); the old directory always goes.

decisions.summary: wip/README.md KEPT against the reader's DELETE, raised with the GM
decisions.why: Implied by the GM's own standing words (readme-hooks.sh quotes them: 'you personally should literally never touch a readme file'; its one escape needs the GM delegating in their own words). 'see which ones should be ... deleted' asks for a judgment, which the audit records, not an explicit README delegation. Cost is one stale 44-line file that names no path (0 prefix hits), and it is raised with the GM.
